clips.title: The story
paras: Along the southern Barrens road near Bael Modan, Gann Stonespire seeks retaliation for his people’s displacement. The tauren nomad’s tribe hunted on land now occupied by a dwarven excavation.

Gann Stonespire camps beside the southern Barrens road after the dwarven expedition arrived from Ironforge and built Bael Modan. The surrounding land had been his tribe’s ancestral territory and hunting grounds. Dwarven miners drove the tauren from their soil with pickaxes, firearms, and heavy machinery, and refused peaceful overtures. Gann will not surrender his heritage quietly. He calls on travelers to strike back at the excavators.
